correctness.rationale: The finite algebra basis is {1,x_i^s:1<=s<a_i}. Pairwise least-common-multiple monomial syzygies constrain each pure power P_i to images V_i comprising nonconstant x_i-powers and top x_j^{a_j-1} on other axes; each mixed Q_ij maps to W_ij comprising nonconstant i/j powers and top powers on other axes. The remaining syzygies impose no further constraints. Shifting generator weights gives the complete Hilbert tangent character H. The cotangent exact sequence Der(A)->Der(S,A)->Hom_S(I,A)->T1->0, with explicit Der(A) character D and Der(S,A) character B sum t_i^-1, yields T1=H-B sum t_i^-1+D. Dimensions rd+r(r-2)(r+1)/2 and d-1+r(r^2+r-4)/2. Independent rational pair-lcm linear-system calculations at all-two exponents recovered r=4: d=5, tangent=40, derivation-image rank=4, T1=36; r=5: d=6, tangent=75, derivation-image rank=5, T1=70.
